description: Use this when the person wants a different exercise in a session (a busy machine, a sore joint, missing kit). Lists the swaps that train the same movement in that slot and week, best first, by sessionId and slot. Nothing changes; swap with swap_exercise. Do not use to explain how an exercise is done; use show_exercise.

sessionId.description: The session's id, from get_today or get_schedule.

slot.description: The exercise's slot in that session, from get_today or get_session.

name: list_alternatives
title: Swaps for an exercise
